messages:
priya_cs: FYI MapleCloud renewal due 4/06. They want to move to a 9-month term, split invoice across MAPLE-US (70%) and MAPLE-EU (30%), apply remaining onboarding credit ($12,000) as a one-time line item, and sign an amendment + SOW. Need legal + billing path and confirmation we can accept two POs and DocuSign only. Quote: https://redwoodhq.co/quotes/MC-342  

liam_sales: Spoke with procurement — 9-mo ties to Q3. They're OK with current rates if the onboarding credit is applied up front. They'll issue two POs (US + EU). We should accept both and have one amendment reference both POs. @anya_legal any blockers?

anya_legal: We can do a 9-mo addendum. Need exact legal entity names, billing addresses, and whether EU PO includes VAT or reverse-charge. Also confirm signatory flow: PO + DocuSign for the amendment is usually fine but need authorized signatory on the PO. Send entity names and I'll draft language.

jake_billing: We can split invoices. Billing needs: vendor codes for both entities, billing contact emails, and PO numbers. For the credit: easiest is a negative line on the first invoice. Need GL code and description to post correctly. Example invoice snippet I can generate: 
```
invoice_lines = [
  {"desc": "9-month Redwood subscription (MAPLE-US)", "amount": 70000},
  {"desc": "Onboarding credit (one-time)", "amount": -12000} 
]
```
I can prepare two invoice templates (US + EU) once I have vendor codes.

eve_pm: Onboarding asks to hold kickoff until amendment signed and credit applied. Tentative enablement week of 4/15 — I can prep the checklist and scoping materials but need firm dates after signature.

esignbot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/0x9a  — status: created. Routing order set to liam_sales -> priya_cs -> anya_legal.

priya_cs: Next steps: 1) liam to confirm entity legal names + POs, 2) jake to create invoice templates & GL mapping, 3) anya to draft 9-mo addendum and VAT clause, 4) eve to tentatively block 4/15 for enablement, 5) I'll upload quote + SOW to the envelope and ping when ready. I'll also confirm whether customer needs separate SOW per entity (they said single SOW preferred).

liam_sales: Will get POs + legal names by EOD tomorrow. Customer also asked for a short usage-cap notification (notify at 80% usage) and a soft cap at +15% without explicit approval — thinking to include a short operational clause. @anya_legal ok?

anya_legal: Short operational notice clause is fine — keep it non-financial. I'll draft a one-liner and attach to the amendment. Sending first draft by EOD.

priya_cs: Thanks — adding action items to CS tracker and will follow up here once docs are in the envelope. :thumbsup:
